TU HI ZARIYA

TU HI HEELA

MERI BAKSHISH KA WASILA

HAR GHADI MERA WAZIFA

MERE HAR GHAM KA MADAWA

SYED NA HUSSAIN HUSSAIN MURSHADNA HUSSAIN

TU DEE’N KA SUTOON HAI TU DEE’N KA QARAR

MOHSIN HAI TU HI DEEN KA TU DEEN KA WAQAAR

KISSE MISAL DUN TERI KISME KARUN SHUMAR

RIFFAT KO TERI DEKH KE KEHTI HAI KARBALA

SYED NA HUSSAIN HUSSAIN MURSHADNA HUSSAIN×2

BATIL HAR KE DAUR ME PATA RAHA ZAWAL

AUJE HUSSAINIYAT ME NA DEKHA GAYA ZAWAL

TERE ADU KA HISSA KHATA O SAZA ZAWAL

HAR DAUR TERI JEET HAI HAR DAUR KARBALA

SYED NA HUSSAIN HUSSAIN MURSHADNA HUSSAIN×2

HOJATA SAB HALAK TABAHI KE ZAD ME THA

DEENE RASOOL E PAK TABAHI KE ZAD ME THA

INSAAN DARDNAAK TABAHI KE ZAD ME THA

JAA’N DEKH TU NE BAKSHI HAI HAR EK KO JALA

SYED NA HUSSAIN HUSSAIN MURSHADNA HUSSAIN×2

BATIL BUTON SE HAQ KI TARAF RUKH KO MOD KAR

HUR AAYA JAB HAI SHAM KE LASHKAR KO CHORDKAR

KEHNE LAGA HUSSAIN SE YEH HAATH JOD KAR

RAB KI QASAM HAI RAHE JINA SAATH AAPKA

SYED NA HUSSAIN HUSSAIN MURSHADNA HUSSAIN×2

MARQAD KI WEHSHATON KA MUJHE KOI GHAM NAHI

APNI MUSIBATON KA MUJHE KOI GHAM NAHI

AUR GHAM KE MARHALON KA MUJHE KOI GHAM NAHI

DETA HAR EK GHAM KO TERA GHAM HAI HAUSLA

SYED NA HUSSAIN HUSSAIN MURSHADNA HUSSAIN×2

YEH JUSTAJU YEH HAQ KI TALABGARI KAM NA HO

MOULA TUMHARE GHAR SE WAFADARI KAM NA HO

MUSHKIL HO KOI BHI YEH AZADARI KAM NA HO

KARTE HAIN BAS KHUDA SE AZADAR YEH DUA

SYED NA HUSSAIN HUSSAIN MURSHADNA HUSSAIN×2

MOUJ E SITAM UTHEN BHI TO SAHIL NA CHUSAKEN

KALI GHATAYEN ZULM KI HAR SIMT CHAGAYEN

LEKIN TERI SHUWAON KI HAD TAK NA AASAKE

SURAJ TERI HAYAT KA ROSHAN RAHA SADA

BETE KI LASH DOSH PE THA RAB KA SHUKRIYA

KARKE SUPURD KHAK KIYA RAB KA SHUKRIYA

HAR GAAM PE TU KARTA RAHA RAB KA SHUKRIYA

TUJHKO SALAM SABR O TAHMUL NE KHUD KIYA

ITNI KAHAN THI FIKR E SHANWAR KI RAFFATEN

AAMIR JO ZAM HUSSAIN KI KARTA YEH AZMATEN

UNKI NAWAZSHISEN HAIN YEH UNKI INAYATEN

SOCHA THA BAS HUSSAIN KO AUR MISRA HOGAYA

SYED NA HUSSAIN HUSSAIN MURSHADNA HUSSAIN

عامر جو ضم حسین کی کرتا یہ عظمتیں
ان کی نوازشیں ہیں یہ ان کی عنایتیں

سیدنا حسین حسین مرشدنا حسین\"\"\".splitlines()
sizes = [6, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 4, 4, 5]
assert sum(sizes) == len(roman) == len(source)
def stanza_text(lines, digits):
    blocks = []
    offset = 0
    for i, size in enumerate(sizes):
        stanza = lines[offset:offset + size]
        if i:
            stanza.insert(0, digits[i - 1])
        blocks.append('\\n'.join(stanza))
        offset += size
    return '\\n\\n'.join(blocks)
metadata = metadata.strip('\\n').replace('title: \"Syedna Hussain\"', 'title: \"سیدنا حسین\"\\nalternateTitle: \"Syedna Hussain\"').replace('direction: \"ltr\"', 'direction: \"rtl\"').replace('tags: [\"noUrdu\"]\\n', '')
roman_block = '\\n'.join('  ' + line if line else '' for line in stanza_text(roman, '123456789').splitlines())
assert [line.upper() for line in roman] == [line.removesuffix('×2') for line in body.splitlines() if line.strip()]
p.write_text(f'---\\n{metadata}\\nromanLyrics: |-\\n{roman_block}\\n---\\n\\n{stanza_text(source, \"۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹\")}\\n')

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu text of *Syedna Hussain* and preserved all 49 Roman verse lines in `romanLyrics`, with matching stanza breaks. Removed the recitation repeat markers and the `noUrdu` tag. Only the selected lyric was edited.

The reading `zam` in the closing stanza is ambiguous. I kept it in the Roman transcription and rendered it tentatively as `ضم` in Urdu.
